name: @cloudsforge/beacon-web
description: The operator console for micro-beacon: the release gate first, then the journeys, probes, incidents, conformance and error budgets it decides on.
//test: --import @cloudsforge/ui/test-loader is load-bearing and is NOT optional decoration. link: symlinks micro-ui's WORKING TREE, whose own node_modules holds the react it needs to test itself, and Node resolves a bare specifier from the importing file's REALPATH — so the design system's components find that second copy, share no dispatcher with ours, and every hook they call throws "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useState')". The loader is vite's resolve.dedupe supplied to the Node test runner, which has none of its own. Copied from micro-status-web's package.json, which is where the estate wrote it down. Delete the flag and the suite goes red, not quiet.
//: @cloudsforge/ui is consumed from a sibling path because it is not published yet. It becomes a registry version ('^1.0.0') the day it is, and nothing else here changes — the Dockerfile's uipkg build context and the second checkout in ci.yml go with it. The specifier is link: rather than file: because pnpm PACKS a file: directory, honouring that package's `files` field, which lists only dist — the installed copy would then have an exports map pointing at sources that were never packed. link: symlinks the working tree, which is also what makes an edit in the design system visible here without a republish. JSON has no comment syntax, hence this key.
